power_button_pcap.counts: 11444 frames of 48 bytes type 0x20; a single 32-byte frame

classification: One GIP input type (0x20, header 20 00 <seq> 2c) with a SHORT 32-byte form during the first ~46 s after enumeration and a 48-byte steady-state form thereafter. Same capture, same device, so this is not a decoder artefact.
retraction: The earlier report's 594-of-32-bytes histogram came from a head-limited slice of the opening frames of that capture, i.e. exactly the startup phase, and was wrongly generalised. Steady-state length is 48.
not_proven: what changes at t~45.8 s (xpad init completion vs controller extended state) is not proven
